mapper.select: select l.library_id as libraryId, l.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, l.name, l.status from sys_user u join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id and d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' join kb_library l on l.dept_id = d.dept_id and l.status = 'enabled' where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0'

select l.library_id as libraryId, l.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, l.name, l.status from kb_library l join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = l.dept_id and d.del_flag = '0' order by d.parent_id, d.order_num, d.dept_id
mapper.insert: insert into kb_library (dept_id, name) select dept_id, #{name} from sys_dept where dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
